question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a purple ball, Bob has a green ball, Claire has a gold ball, Dave has a yellow ball, Eve has a pink ball, Fred has a teal ball, and Gertrude has a orange ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Fred swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Fred and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) purple ball
(B) green ball
(C) gold ball
(D) yellow ball
(E) pink ball
(F) teal ball
(G) orange ball
solution:
Ball colors in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude.
Initial: purple | green | gold | yellow | pink | teal | orange
1. Fred–Alice: teal | green | gold | yellow | pink | purple | orange
2. Claire–Fred: teal | green | purple | yellow | pink | gold | orange
3. Eve–Claire: teal | green | pink | yellow | purple | gold | orange
4. Fred–Claire: teal | green | gold | yellow | purple | pink | orange
5. Dave–Bob: teal | yellow | gold | green | purple | pink | orange
6. Gertrude–Claire: teal | yellow | orange | green | purple | pink | gold
7. Gertrude–Bob: teal | gold | orange | green | purple | pink | yellow
Fred has the pink ball, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
